description: This Python source file defines an in-memory task management repository with functions for user registration, authentication, task creation, retrieval, updating, and deletion. It includes mocked data stores and is intended as a placeholder before integrating with a database such as Supabase or PostgreSQL.

methods.name: init_workspace()
methods.description: Initializes the in-memory stores for users and tasks, simulating workspace setup.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] register_user(email: str, password: str)
methods.description: Registers a new user with email and password, generating a UUID for the user ID.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] authenticate_user(email: str, password: str)
methods.description: Authenticates a user based on email and password, returning user info if successful.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] get_user_by_id(user_id: str)
methods.description: Fetches a user object based on the user ID.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] create_task(user_id: str, title: str, description: Optional[str], status: str)
methods.description: Creates a new task for a user with title, description, and status, assigning a UUID and timestamps.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] list_tasks(user_id: str)
methods.description: Returns all tasks associated with a specific user ID.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] get_task(task_id: str, user_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieves a task by its ID for a given user.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] update_task(task_id: str, user_id: str, updates: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Updates fields of an existing task, including title, description, and status.

methods.name: bool delete_task(task_id: str, user_id: str)
methods.description: Deletes a task by its ID for the specified user.
